# 🚀 PrabhatSMPEssentials 
### ⚡ The Ultimate Lightweight SMP Utility Plugin  

**Author:** PrabhatPie  
**Minecraft Version:** 1.21+  
**Platform:** Paper / Spigot  

---

## 🌟 Overview  
**PrabhatSMPEssentials** is a **high-performance, lightweight, and fully optimized SMP plugin** that provides all essential SMP features in one powerful system.  

Designed for **modern Paper servers**, it ensures:  
- ⚡ Lag-free performance  
- 🧩 Modular architecture  
- 🔒 Secure systems  
- 🎯 Smooth GUI experience  

Perfect for both **small SMPs** and **large community servers**.

---

## 🔥 Features  

### 🏠 Home System  
- `/sethome <name>` – Set a home  
- `/home <name>` – Teleport to home  
- `/delhome <name>` – Delete a home  

✔ Permission-based limits  
✔ Player data storage (no database)  
✔ Fast & efficient  

---

### 🌍 Spawn System  
- `/setspawn` – Set server spawn *(Admin)*  
- `/spawn` – Teleport to spawn  

✔ Saved in `config.yml`  
✔ Instant teleport  

---

### 🏙️ Hub System  
- `/sethub` – Set hub *(Admin)*  
- `/hub` – Teleport to hub  

✔ Separate hub support  

---

### 🛡️ Lobby Protection  
- `/setlobby` – Set lobby world  

🚫 Disabled in lobby:  
- Block breaking / placing  
- Item dropping / pickup  
- Entity damage  

✔ Admin bypass  
✔ Safe lobby environment  

---

### 🎲 Random Teleport (RTP)  
- `/rtp` – Random safe teleport  

✔ Avoids lava, water, caves  
✔ Safe Y-level detection  
✔ Async teleport (no lag)  
✔ 60s cooldown  

---

### 🔁 Teleport Request System  
- `/tpa <player>`  
- `/tpahere <player>`  
- `/tpaccept`  
- `/tpdeny`  

✔ Auto-expire (60s)  
✔ Cancel on logout  
✔ Anti-spam protection  

---

### 🔙 Back System  
- `/back` – Return to last location  

✔ Works after:  
- RTP  
- TPA  
- Home  
- Spawn / Hub  
- Death  

---

### 📦 GUI Menu System  
- `/menu` – Open main menu  

🧭 **Menu (27 slots):**  
- Ender Pearl → RTP  
- Player Head → TPA GUI  
- Oak Door → Homes GUI  
- Compass → Spawn  
- Arrow → Back  
- Nether Star → Hub  
- Gold Ingot → Auction House  
- Book → Server Info  

✔ No item movement  
✔ Anti-duplication protection  
![Gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1645f95378e0ff1247fd48c1e501f6659c6c6c6a_0.webp)
---

### 👥 TPA GUI  
- Shows all online players  
- Click to send TPA request  

✔ Clean player-head interface  

---

### 🏠 Homes GUI  
- View all homes visually  
- Set / delete homes  

✔ Simple & user-friendly  

---

### 💰 Auction House  
- `/ah` – Open auction  
- `/ah sell <price>` – List item  
- `/ah search <item>` – Search  

✔ GUI-based system  
✔ Click to buy items  
✔ Shows seller & price  

📜 Example Lore:  
- Seller: PlayerName  
- Price: ₹500  
- Click to purchase  
![Auction House](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01af13c8421e686d5ecbf323288917e9d5bb3c3c.jpeg)
---

### 📊 Auction Limits  
Controlled via permissions:  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.1`  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.3`  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.5`  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.10`  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.unlimited`  

---

### ⚙️ Configurable System  

`spawn:
  world: world
  x: 0
  y: 64
  z: 0

hub:
  world: world
  x: 100
  y: 70
  z: 50

lobby-world: lobby

rtp:
  cooldown: 60

auction-house:
  enabled: true
  listing-fee: 0
  default-limit: 1`

  ## 🔐 Permissions  

### 👑 Admin Permissions  
- `smpessentials.*` → Grants **all permissions**  
- `smpessentials.admin` → Full admin access  

### ⚙️ Admin Commands Permissions  
- `smpessentials.admin` → Access to:  
  - `/setspawn`  
  - `/sethub`  
  - `/setlobby`  

✔ Admins automatically bypass:  
- Teleport cooldowns  
- Lobby protection  
- Home limits  
- Auction limits  

---

### 🎮 Player Permissions  
- `smpessentials.spawn` → Use `/spawn`  
- `smpessentials.hub` → Use `/hub`  
- `smpessentials.rtp` → Use `/rtp`  
- `smpessentials.tpa` → Use `/tpa`, `/tpahere`, `/tpaccept`, `/tpdeny`  
- `smpessentials.home` → Use home commands  
- `smpessentials.back` → Use `/back`  
- `smpessentials.menu` → Open `/menu`  
- `smpessentials.ah` → Use auction house  

---

### 🏠 Home Limits Permissions  
- `smpessentials.home.1` → 1 home  
- `smpessentials.home.3` → 3 homes  
- `smpessentials.home.5` → 5 homes  
- `smpessentials.home.unlimited` → Unlimited homes  

---

### 💰 Auction Limits Permissions  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.1` → 1 listing  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.3` → 3 listings  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.5` → 5 listings  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.10` → 10 listings  
- `smpessentials.ah.limit.unlimited` → Unlimited listings  

---
